ننفضح (form VII)
# نَنْفَضِحُ (nanfaḍiḥu) /nan.fa.dˤi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# نَنْفَضِحَ (nanfaḍiḥa) /nan.fa.dˤi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# نَنْفَضِحْ (nanfaḍiḥ) /nan.fa.dˤiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
